review.reason: Standard R6 humanoid training dummy rig with complete Motor6D joint hierarchy and Humanoid; suitable as combat target model requiring game-level combat integration.

serializedMedia.purpose: Default R6 face decal applied to the dummy head

requirements.reason: Complete R6 humanoid structure with HumanoidRootPart, Torso, limbs, Neck, and Root/Hip/Shoulder Motor6D joints present.
Dummy contains a base Humanoid with health, but requires server-side health management, defeat state handling, and reset scripting.
Rig provides target geometry and joint hierarchy for combat interactions, but combat attack combo animations and logic must be implemented via separate scripts.

permissionImpacts.reason: No DataStore APIs used; asset contains only static model geometry and joints.
No HTTP or external network calls present in the static model.
No global variables or shared table manipulations present.

integrationNotes: Position the Dummy model in the arena training zone facing the player spawn point.
Add server-side combat hit detection, health tracking, and flinch/defeat state handlers.
Attach target indicator highlights or visual decals to torso and head parts as requested.
